changes.title: Music stops
items: The music no longer piles up notes when the game slows (which made it crackle and could silence it), and if the sound ever stops it starts itself again

changes.title: Fire smoke
items: Campfires, bonfires, torches and the charcoal burner's mound send up soft puffs of smoke that rise high over the treetops, drift with the wind and fade away, moonlit grey with the firelight on the low ones

changes.title: Creator boxes
items: Dressing her up: each thing she wears has its own box with its own colour picker, one open at a time
Walk her up to her things in the bedroom (the rail, the mirror, the hats, the broom...) to open their box
